$Comment: Teaches the three motions a camp needs: fell timber, place anything, then place the campfire.
Order groups the steps rather than Flow.Sequential, so chopping and building run side by side
(both Order 1) and only the campfire waits for them (Order 2). The build step names no Target,
which means any block counts - it is about the habit, not about a particular wall.
The campfire step is EXACT so a decorative fire bench of another kind does not close it.
